config.missing_entities: {field} is missing: at least three of the four balance quantities must be configured as sensors.
config.mixed_form: {field}: use either an entity id, the entity/invert form, the two-entity form or derived - not a mixture.
config.two_derived: Only one balance quantity may be derived; {field} would be the second one.
config.soc_stops: {field} needs at least two stops in ascending order, the first at 0 and the last at 100.
config.soc_stop_entry: {field} needs a numeric at value and a colour.
config.duplicate_consumer: {field}: the entity {entity} is listed more than once.

editor_help.min_consumer_w: Consumers below this power are hidden and counted towards the remainder.
editor_help.max_consumers: Only the strongest consumers are listed; the rest are counted together. Empty = all.
editor_help.update_interval_s: How often the list reorders. The figures themselves update immediately.
editor_help.rest_label: Name for the part that is not measured individually. Default: "Other".
editor_help.show_selector: Shows or hides the switches at the top of the card. The active mode stays visible either way.
editor_help.inactive_lines: Connections with nothing flowing on them. "Hide" calms the picture at night.
editor_help.animation: "Follow system setting" respects the device's reduce-motion preference - that lives in the operating system, not in Home Assistant.
editor_help.battery_soc: State of charge in percent. Never averaged.
editor_help.color: Any CSS value, e.g. #7e57c2 or var(--primary-color). Empty = automatic.
editor_help.solar: Positive = production. If the sensor reports production as negative, flip the sign.
editor_help.grid: Positive = import from the grid, negative = export. If your sensor has it the other way round, flip the sign.
editor_help.house: Total consumption of the house. Without a sensor of its own, choose "Derived".
editor_help.battery: Positive = discharging, negative = charging (Home Assistant's convention). If your sensor has it the other way round, flip the sign.
editor_help.battery_charge: Charging from all sources, as a magnitude ≥ 0.
editor_help.derived: Calculated from the other three quantities so the balance adds up. Only one quantity can be derived.
